description: d_min=0.08 â€” late-time production (months 60-72) flattens around 550-720 bbl/month, declining only ~3%/month vs the 5% terminal rate baseline assumes. Higher d_min should better capture this flattening tail.

outlier_threshold=0.20 â€” outlier_rejection_rate was 0% despite clear operational dips at months 10 (2257 vs ~6000 trend), 20 (1034 vs ~3500 trend), 40 (747 vs ~1300 trend), and 53 (391 vs ~800 trend). Lowering threshold from 0.30 to 0.20 should flag these anomalous months and improve the fit.

qi_guess_strategy=max3 â€” first month (13481) may underestimate true IP since months 1-3 show 13481, 11155, 7779. Averaging top 3 months gives ~11200, providing optimizer a higher qi seed that may better capture the steep initial decline (di=0.72 fitted) and improve holdout forecast.

smoothing_window=5 â€” production has sharp single-month dips (months 10, 20, 22, 40, 53) that aren't caught by outlier detection (0% rejection rate). Wider smoothing window should dampen these anomalies and give the curve fitter cleaner input data.

significance_threshold=0.35 â€” current threshold of 0.50 may be detecting decline start too late. Production drops 17% from month 1 to 2 (13481â†’11155) and 30% from month 2 to 3 (11155â†’7779). Lower threshold should anchor the decline start earlier at the true peak, potentially fitting the steep early decline better.

qi_multiplier_upper=8.0 â€” fitted qi=15126 vs first-month production=13481 gives a multiplier of 1.12. Current upper bound of 5.0 may be fine, but raising to 8.0 widens the optimizer search space, allowing it to explore higher qi values paired with steeper di, which could better match the rapid early decline and improve the holdout forecast.

b_upper_bound=0.60 â€” fitted b=0.6631 at baseline. Constraining b below this forces optimizer toward more exponential decline. The production drops 50% in first 6 months (13481â†’7371) then transitions to slower decline, which may be better fit by a lower b with compensating di/qi adjustments.

outlier_threshold=0.15 â€” most aggressive outlier detection in search space. Despite clear single-month production dips (month 10: 2257 vs ~6000 trend, month 20: 1034 vs ~3500 trend), outlier rejection rate has been 0% at thresholds 0.20 and 0.30. Testing floor of range to see if any data points are filtered.

outlier_window=7 â€” wider rolling window should create a more stable median baseline to detect single-month dips against. With window=3, the median is too close to the data to detect outliers. Window=7 gives 3 months on each side, making dips at months 10, 20, 40 stand out more clearly from the local trend.

qi_guess_strategy=peak_value â€” using actual peak production value as qi seed. Month 1 has 13481 bbl which is the peak, so this may give the optimizer a tighter initial bracket than 'first' or 'max3', potentially finding a better local minimum for the holdout forecast.

significance_threshold=0.70 â€” higher threshold may skip the first few months of steep, irregular decline (months 1-4 show 13481, 11155, 7779, 8992 with a reversal at month 4) and start fitting from a more stable decline period, potentially improving holdout accuracy.
